policies.metrics: Recall@k and RR@k per query; macro Recall@k and MRR@k = arithmetic mean over queries with at least one judged-relevant document (same query set and denominator for every method).
policies.no_judged_relevant: metrics are null (JSON null / blank CSV), status 'no_judged_relevant'; excluded from macro means; counted in 'no_judged_relevant'. A null is never a zero.
policies.empty_ranking_for_answerable_query: scores 0 and stays in the macro denominator.
policies.unjudged_documents: contribute zero gain, keep their rank, labeled 'unjudged' (distinct from an explicit 0 judgment, labeled 'nonrelevant').
policies.ranking_order: score descending, then doc_id ascending (case-sensitive), applied to the full ranking before truncation to max_k. Scores are comparable only within one method.
policies.ranking_consistency: Every first-call, warm-up and measured search must return the same ORDERED document IDs as the untimed quality-pass ranking of that (method, query). A different ordered ID list makes the run incomplete (stage 'consistency', run_failed.json with the diagnostic, no run.json). If the IDs match but scores differ, the run may complete and the differences are reported separately.
policies.json: NaN/Infinity are rejected; absent values are null.

embedding.name: embedding
embedding.normalization: L2, float64, applied to document and query embeddings in the adapter
embedding.search: exhaustive dot product (= cosine similarity on unit vectors)

timing_protocol.method_order_rule: Per query: warm-up calls first, always in listed method order [bm25, embedding] and discarded; then measured repetitions. In measured repetition i (0-based) the methods run in the listed order rotated left by (i mod 2), i.e. the first method alternates each repetition.
timing_protocol.timed_region: raw query text in -> ranked (doc_id, score) list out: query tokenization/encoding, scoring, ordering and top-k, as implemented inside retriever.search().
timing_protocol.median: middle value of the sorted sample; mean of the two middle values when the count is even
timing_protocol.p95: nearest rank: sorted value at 1-based rank ceil(0.95 * n)
timing_protocol.overall_summary: pools all measured calls of one method (equal repetitions per query)
timing_protocol.caveats: warm, local, serial microbenchmark observations on one machine. Repeated calls of the same query are not independent samples and are not evidence of statistical significance. No latency target.

ranking_consistency.rule: Every first-call, warm-up and measured search must return the same ORDERED document IDs as the untimed quality-pass ranking of that (method, query). A different ordered ID list makes the run incomplete (stage 'consistency', run_failed.json with the diagnostic, no run.json). If the IDs match but scores differ, the run may complete and the differences are reported separately.
